g.text: U2-only tap after the existing head fuse. Shared C2/C3 BUS bypasses this circuit; upstream D8/D14 remain external.

g.desc: U2-only tap after the existing head fuse. Shared C2/C3 BUS bypasses this circuit; upstream D8/D14 remain external.

g.text: Steady source: 15-20.5 V stand / 30-42 V robot BUS. Transient envelope is unknown.

g.desc: Steady source: 15-20.5 V stand / 30-42 V robot BUS. Transient envelope is unknown.

g.text: PG and both VRP pads: NC

g.desc: PG and both VRP pads: NC

g.text: Q1/Q2: common SOURCE and GATE; intrinsic diode cathodes face the outer drains. Every real package lead is exported.

g.desc: Q1/Q2: common SOURCE and GATE; intrinsic diode cathodes face the outer drains. Every real package lead is exported.

g.text: SENSE/VOUT labels are Kelvin taps at R1 pad edges. R8 is in the C2 ramp branch only, not in series with the MOSFET gates.

g.desc: SENSE/VOUT labels are Kelvin taps at R1 pad edges. R8 is in the C2 ramp branch only, not in series with the MOSFET gates.

g.text: RETRY=GND latches forward overcurrent only. SHDN_DIV defaults ON; UV/OV recovery is AUTOMATIC. FAULT is unused.

g.desc: RETRY=GND latches forward overcurrent only. SHDN_DIV defaults ON; UV/OV recovery is AUTOMATIC. FAULT is unused.

g.text: Grounding SHDN_DIV clears a forward fault. This service/reset node is NOT the ARM line or an emergency stop.

g.desc: Grounding SHDN_DIV clears a forward fault. This service/reset node is NOT the ARM line or an emergency stop.

g.text: OPEN RELEASE GATES: +BUS surge envelope, -42V reverse fault (controller limit -40V), startup current/SOA, thermal and EMI.

g.desc: OPEN RELEASE GATES: +BUS surge envelope, -42V reverse fault (controller limit -40V), startup current/SOA, thermal and EMI.

g.text: No 12V regeneration clamp is selected; the 12.6V servo limit is NOT proven. PAN_INPUT <=55V is a target, not a guarantee.

g.desc: No 12V regeneration clamp is selected; the 12.6V servo limit is NOT proven. PAN_INPUT <=55V is a target, not a guarantee.

g.text: No PCB, extra-board location, qualified pad layout or service-clearance approval. Read README.md, pins.md and fault-review.md.

g.desc: No PCB, extra-board location, qualified pad layout or service-clearance approval. Read README.md, pins.md and fault-review.md.

g.text: PAN SUPPLY CANDIDATE | UNSELECTED / UNQUALIFIED | NOT FOR FABRICATION OR ENERGIZATION

g.desc: PAN SUPPLY CANDIDATE | UNSELECTED / UNQUALIFIED | NOT FOR FABRICATION OR ENERGIZATION
